title: hieracium stelligerum subsp. albogilvum
intro: Hieracium stelligerum subsp. albogilvum, commonly known as the Alpine Hawkweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which have been used to treat various health issues, including inflammation and digestive problems. The health benefits of Hieracium stelligerum subsp. albogilvum include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immune-modulating effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids.
